prompts.name: main_base
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: original GameForge cozy HD pixel-art fishing RPG character sprite sheet. Match reference player proportions: large head about one third height, compact 3-head-tall body, detailed crisp pixel clusters, dark warm outline, upper-left light, warm cream/brown/teal palette, fixed elevated orthographic JRPG view. True transparent alpha background, no painted checkerboard, shadows, text, labels, borders or scenery. Exactly 16 isolated full-body sprites in a regular 4 column by 4 row grid on 1536x1536 canvas. Rows top to bottom down/front, left/profile, right/profile, up/back. Columns walking phases left-foot contact, passing, right-foot contact, passing. Keep same identity and limb lengths across all cells; feet baseline at 340,724,1108,1492 respectively; cell centers x192,576,960,1344; character visible height 270 pixels, large clear gutters; soles complete. Subtle believable alternating walk, no dramatic poses. Original design, no franchise copies. Primary request: customizable adult main-character BASE, androgynous warm tan skin, short neat dark chestnut hair without hat, friendly dark eyes, neutral fitted ivory short-sleeve undershirt, plain charcoal fitted knee-length base shorts, simple dark brown ankle shoes. Modest fully clothed neutral foundation intended for later outfit replacement; no accessories. Use same head and body in all frames.

prompts.name: standing_outfits
prompts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: GameForge home-page equipped-outfit standing sprite atlas. Input images: base, everyday, fishing, event sheets are exact character identity and clothes references. Create exactly FOUR isolated FRONT-FACING STANDING full-body sprites in one horizontal row on a wide transparent 1536x768 canvas. Left to right: neutral ivory shirt/charcoal shorts BASE; teal waistcoat/cream rolled sleeves/russet neckerchief/brown trousers EVERYDAY; moss green two-pocket vest/cream sleeves/ochre scarf/slate cuffed short trousers/tall brown boots FISHING; burgundy waistcoat/ivory long sleeves/teal tie/charcoal trousers EVENT. Same tan skin, short chestnut hair, face, warm dark eyes, compact head/body ratio as references. Feet side by side resting on SAME horizontal baseline, arms relaxed symmetrically, no walk or raised legs. Character height, head size and x center registration identical across four outfits. Crisp detailed warm HD pixel-art clusters, elevated orthographic view, upper-left light. Broad clear gutters on every side. Actual alpha transparency, no shadows, backdrop, checkerboard, text, labels or props. Preserve reference identity exactly; do not embellish costumes.

prompts.name: wardrobe
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: original GameForge Whisperwind HD wardrobe furniture sprite. Input image is furniture style reference only; ignore its backdrop. Create one isolated complete closed two-door oak wardrobe with warm walnut trim, small brass handles and hinges, modest arched crown, two small lower drawers, four short sturdy legs. Subtle teal carved leaf motif, cozy handmade village furniture, no mirror. Crisp detailed HD pixel-art clusters matching the bed/bookshelf reference, fixed elevated orthographic camera showing front and right side, upper-left light. Entire silhouette centered, generous transparent margin on all sides. True alpha transparent background, no glow, gradient, floor, scenery, shadow, text or characters. World display intended 115 units wide by about 170 high. Doors CLOSED; no costume items baked in. Original design.

prompts.name: wardrobe_transparency_fix
prompts.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: supplied wardrobe image. Remove ONLY all background and all glow, dark vignette, floor and shadows. Replace the entire outside of the cabinet silhouette with real fully transparent alpha pixels. Preserve the wardrobe itself exactly: wood, brass trim, teal motifs, closed doors, drawer handles, four feet and upper-left lighting. Do not add, reposition or redraw the furniture. No soft halo. Transparent isolated game furniture cutout with clean crisp pixel-art boundary.
